needs.role: Reusable compact sky obby or floating-island course component whose verified geometry, route language, landmarks, or included obstacle behavior can support the short three-checkpoint course without becoming a sprawling map.
needs.constraints: Prefer compact readable floating geometry with broad walkable surfaces and clear silhouettes. Inspect all included scripts, moving obstacles, checkpoints, sounds, animations, dependencies, spawn behavior, and finish behavior before reuse. Retain useful verified portions inside Workspace/Forge_c405e7e9b70b only; do not import unrelated monetization, leaderboards, saving, combat, admin, or large-map systems. A decorative scene alone does not satisfy traversal requirements.

intent.experienceRole: Supplies a cohesive spatial and visual foundation so the run reads as one authored sky route rather than disconnected test parts.
intent.interaction: The player physically follows its retained walkable route from the start island toward the visible finish. Geometry is interactive as traversal space; any included scripted obstacle behavior is retained only after inspection and native verification.
